headline: Front-Line Base Battles Intensify in Several Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition, the most conspicuous movement has come at Stonecradle, where the current ledger records 18 strategic-base events, up from 13, with three more in the last two hours and fighting rates accelerating. PalantineBerm remains the busiest watched sector at 48 daily events, including three in the latest two hours; its holdings stand four Warden, three Colonial, with no neutral base. WeatheredExpanse has reached 39 events, though its combat and enlistment rates are cooling, and its line remains seven Warden, two neutral. LinnMercy is still unsettled at 31 events, with one Warden, nine Colonial, and one neutral holding; recent casualties and enlistments have accelerated despite a quieter immediate window. MarbanHollow holds at 29 events and a four-Warden, three-Colonial, one-neutral split, while Gutter remains active at 14 events but has gone quiet in the latest two hours. StlicanShelf is a fresh concern, posting five events in two hours amid sharply rising casualties and enlistments. Most other fronts show no base movement in the latest day, leaving these sectors as the principal watches for the next dispatch.
